title: Setup → Create User with a typed password still shows "If a temporary password was generated, copy it now" (#27521 row 12)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 12 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator creating a user with a typed password. What happens: the result dialog still reads "If a temporary password was generated, copy it now — it is shown only once and never stored.", though nothing was generated and there is nothing to copy, so the administrator looks for a password that does not exist. Reach: every administrator creating a user with a typed password.

## Mechanism

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: two result texts (create user and set password) carry the conditional sentence unconditionally; on main the generated en bundle has it at `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.objects.generated.ts` lines 194 and 221.
- #24936 (closed) reworded the earlier unconditional "Copy the temporary password now" into this conditional sentence; the line still shows whether or not the server generated a password.

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the source line is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

The copy line only when the server generated a temporary password; a typed password's result says the user was created (or the password set) with no copy line.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Create User with a typed password: the result shows no copy-password line.
- [ ] Create User with Generate Temporary Password: the result shows the generated password and the copy line.
- [ ] Same for Set Password.

Refs #27521
Related: #24936
